# Tests for the -w flag of cmp and cmpenv

# tab-aligned output vs a hand-spaced golden
exec printf 'Direction  Identity  Action\nIngress    12345     Allow\nEgress     6         Allow\n'
! cmp stdout aligned.txt
cmp -w stdout aligned.txt

# a genuine difference is still caught
! cmp -w stdout different.txt

# cmpenv -w expands variables, then ignores whitespace
env WANT_ID=12345
cmpenv -w stdout aligned_env.txt

# leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed
exec printf '   hello   world   \n'
cmp -w stdout trimmed.txt

-- aligned.txt --
Direction Identity Action
Ingress 12345 Allow
Egress 6 Allow
-- different.txt --
Direction Identity Action
Ingress 12345 Deny
Egress 6 Allow
-- aligned_env.txt --
Direction   Identity   Action
Ingress     ${WANT_ID}  Allow
Egress      6           Allow
-- trimmed.txt --
hello world
